R0174.title: On-Chain Privacy Leakage
R0174.definition: The public and transparent nature of blockchain transactions leads to user identity, assets, and transaction behavior privacy information being tracked and analyzed.
R0174.description: All transaction records on public chains are permanently public and accessible. Attackers can use on-chain data analysis, address clustering, transaction graph analysis and other techniques to correlate users' real identities with wallet addresses, track asset flows and transaction habits. Even with pseudonymous addresses, de-anonymization is possible through transaction patterns, amount characteristics, time correlations, etc.
R0174.influence: User assets and transaction privacy completely exposed, becoming targets for targeted attacks, triggering security and regulatory risks.

references.title: Blockchain Security and Privacy: Threats, Challenges, Applications ...

observables: On-chain analysis tools perform address clustering on target wallet addresses, correlating multiple addresses as belonging to the same entity
Pseudonymous addresses are deanonymized and linked to real identities through transaction amount, timing, and counterparty patterns
Large transactions of a user's wallet address are publicly tracked, with asset holdings exposed and becoming extortion or phishing targets
Exchange deposit and withdrawal addresses form an identifiable correlation graph with users' on-chain wallets
